messages:
incident-bot: Paging SRE oncall: GPU pool autoscaler alert - group=gpu-serving, metric_queue_growth > 250 for 3m. Severity: P1. Please acknowledge.

sre-oncall-1: ack - looking now. seeing enqueue growth on inference-queue across west-us cluster.

maria: what's the dashboard link?
sre-oncall-1: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/gpu-serving-overview -> queue depth spiking, pods not scaling. HPA shows desired=0, current=0 despite increased custom metric.

alex: getting a bunch of 429s from the inference-proxy logs for some enterprise customers, latency climbing to 30-45s. customer-support: we've got 3 open escalations.

julian: checking prometheus-adapter logs:```
2026-07-02T10:45:12Z error: unable to fetch metrics: timed out contacting Prometheus (timeout=15s)
2026-07-02T10:46:01Z warn: queue length growing, requeueing requests
2026-07-02T10:47:05Z error: handler panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
```

sre-oncall-1: that looks bad, prometheus-adapter is failing to answer custom metrics API -> HPA can't see GPU_utilization external metric. If HPA can't read metrics it won't scale.

eng-oncall: metrics-server also showing OOMKilled recently, pod restarted multiple times. kube-system/metrics-server logs: ```
E0702 10:44:58.123456 1 reflector.go:205] pkg/mod/k8s.io/client-go/...: Failed to watch *v1.Node: unknown (get nodes)
E0702 10:45:05.789012 1 apiserver.go:145] failed to serve metrics: listen tcp :10250: bind: address already in use
```

sre-oncall-1: immediate mitigation plan: 1) manual scale GPU nodepool + scale deployment replicas to drain queue 2) restart prometheus-adapter and metrics-server 3) enable temporary fallback HPA to use pod CPU instead of external metric for 10m.

ops-bot: runbook step invoked by sre-oncall-1: scale nodepool west-us-gpu by +3.

sre-oncall-1: running kubectl now to bump replicas on inference-service:```
kubectl -n ai scale deploy/inference-service --replicas=12
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter
kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deploy/metrics-server
```

maria: applied the replica scale. we have new pods scheduling but pending because of node shortage - starting nodepool scale.

ops-bot: cloud provider API: requested 3 additional GPU nodes in pool west-us-gpu. expected provisioning ~6-12m.

sre-oncall-2: while nodes come up, we can route lower-priority tenants to a degraded path: set routing rule to offload non-enterprise to cpu-fallback cluster. alex - can you patch router?

alex: pushing patch to routing config:```
PATCH /v1/routes
body: {"route":"/infer","policy":"prefer-cpu-fallback","match":"tenant!=enterprise"}
```

alex: patch accepted. non-enterprise traffic starting to shift (~30% load reduction on GPU pool).

julian: prometheus-adapter pods are back up but logs show high scrape latency to Prometheus:```
WARN: prom query took 22s for gpu_utilization_total{pool="west-us"}
ERROR: adapter: upstream prometheus returned 503 for /api/v1/query_range
```

sre-oncall-1: looks like Prometheus is overloaded - likely retention compaction or long-running queries. We should restart some heavy recording rules consumers and throttle long queries. eng-oncall, can you identify top queries?

eng-oncall: running prometheus query profiler now. top consumers: per-tenant live histogram queries (high-cardinality) and an alerting rule with a 2h lookback window. I'm going to pause that alert rule temporarily.

sre-oncall-2: after the restarts and routing change, queue depth is flattening. traces show fewer 429s, median latency down to ~12s. still not green.

customer-support: notifying impacted customers - sent initial message to impacted enterprise contacts, telling them degraded performance and we are scaling.

maria: quick note: manual HPA fallback implemented by patching HPA to use resource metrics:```
kubectl -n ai patch hpa/gpu-inference-hpa --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/metrics","value":[{"type":"Resource","resource":{"name":"cpu","target":{"type":"Utilization","averageUtilization":60}}}]}]'
```

sre-oncall-1: good. watch for thrashing; set stabilization window to 2m to avoid noisy scaling.

ops-bot: nodepool increased: 3 nodes provisioned and ready. pods are scheduling and starting.

sre-oncall-2: prometheus now responding to adapter queries; custom metric visible again. HPA has updated desired replicas -> autoscaler resuming normal behavior.

alex: rolling metrics: queue depth now back to baseline after ~18 minutes since the first page. enterprise latency still slightly elevated but improving.

incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by sre-oncall-1 at 2026-07-02T10:47:15Z.

sre-oncall-1: paging note for handoff: I'll be on call for 20 more mins then handoff to sre-oncall-2. Key things to watch: Prometheus CPU usage, prometheus-adapter error rate, HPA desired/current divergence, queue depth.

sre-oncall-2: ack - I'll take postmortem and run RCA. immediate hypothesis: Prometheus compaction + high-cardinality queries overloaded Prometheus, adapter timed out -> metrics-server instability caused additional strain on control-plane API calls -> HPA couldn't read external metrics -> no autoscale.

customer-support: all impacted customers have been sent an update. one customer would like a conference bridge to review impact; scheduling now.

julian: creating incident doc and timeline. early actions: manual scale, routing to cpu-fallback, restart adapter/metrics-server, throttle heavy Prom queries, pause expensive alerts.

sre-oncall-1: creating urgent action items: 1) increase retention and throttle policies for per-tenant queries 2) add circuit-breaker on prometheus-adapter to fail-fast when Prometheus overloaded 3) implement HPA fallback with CPU scaling automatically when external metrics unavailable 4) add runbook steps to detect prometheus backlog earlier 5) audit alert rules for expensive queries.

eng-oncall: also recommend increasing resource requests for metrics-server and giving it vertical autoscaling so it doesn't OOM under load.

sre-oncall-2: assigning owners and ETA: julian -> incident doc and timeline (ETA 2h). eng-oncall -> change to prometheus rules (ETA 4h for safe rollout). infra -> automated fallback HPA logic (ETA 2d). monitoring -> add synthetic checks for adapter latency (ETA 1d).

maria: final update: cluster returned to green at 2026-07-02T11:02:00Z. queuing reduced, HPA resumed, enterprise latency within SLO after 22m. Closing notifications after handoff.

sre-oncall-1: handing off to sre-oncall-2 for post-incident work. dropping full logs and commands into the incident doc.

sre-oncall-2: ack handoff. I'll post RCA draft in #postmortems and ping product/security as needed.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved by sre-oncall-2 at 2026-07-02T11:10:20Z (status: mitigated).

customer-support: closing customer update loop; will follow up with next-day postmortem summary to impacted customers.

julian: follow-ups created in Jira: INF-4321 (adapter circuit-breaker), INF-4322 (HPA fallback automation), INF-4323 (prom alert and query audit).

sre-oncall-2: notes for postmortem: include timelines, sample logs (adapter + metrics-server), exact patch diffs for HPA fallback, and customer impact summary (3 escalations, median additional latency 18s, max queue depth +350).

maria: thanks team. good coordination. :raised_hands:
